kind: fanfiction archive: five story archives by subject, each a catalog of stories with full metadata, browse, search and accounts
why: the current Versus target in void-live-deploy/tower.target.json: the smallest site Verse has not beaten, by interactive elements on the home page (owner, 2026-10-29: every site ever made, smallest first)
read: 2026-10-29, through a page fetch; this build network cannot open the site (the tower scan in domains/tower-self.json saw 403), so the counts come from the fetched pages, not a browser DOM
rule: Elevenessee: the target's feature is the floor, not the blueprint. Each feature's plus one is written before the build. Verse's catalog shows only real stories: an empty archive stays clean and looks intentional, never seeded (owner, 2026-10-29).

archives.name: Ashwinder
archives.covers: stories with both Severus Snape and Hermione Granger

archives.name: Chaos
archives.covers: other fandoms, crossovers and original stories

archives.name: Occlumency
archives.covers: Severus Snape, without the Snape and Granger pairing

items: site news: Read more, comments, News Archive
most recent: 4 titles and 12 author names

features.theirs: Story catalog with one row per story and its full metadata (Titles, Most Recent)
features.plus_one: one clean row per story: title, author, rating, summary, categories, characters, genres, warnings, series, chapters, words, complete, published and updated, in Verse's deep space dark look; an empty catalog says so plainly and shows no made-up stories

features.theirs: Browse by category (Browse (15 categories on Lumos))
features.plus_one: every category opens its stories at once with a count beside it, and a reader can ask for a category in words

features.theirs: Browse by character (Browse (canon, original, mystery and other characters))
features.plus_one: pick one or more characters and see only stories with all of them, with the count before you open it

features.theirs: Browse by genre (Browse (18 genres))
features.plus_one: genres combine (romance and mystery) instead of one at a time

features.theirs: Browse by rating (Browse (5 ratings) and the ratings guide)
features.plus_one: the rating filter is on every list, with each rating explained in one line where it is chosen

features.theirs: Content warnings on every story, and browse by warning (story row, Browse (13 warnings))
features.plus_one: warnings show before the summary, and a reader can hide every story with a warning they choose, kept on their device

features.theirs: Author list and author pages (Authors)
features.plus_one: an author page lists every story with its metadata and series, newest first, and can be followed by RSS

features.theirs: Title index A to Z and Other (Titles)
features.plus_one: the A to Z index plus a search that finds a title from a few letters

features.theirs: Sort alphabetically or most recent (Titles)
features.plus_one: sort by title, newest, most words, most hits or most reviews

features.theirs: Filter: all, completed only, work in progress only (Titles)
features.plus_one: completed or in progress combines with every other filter on one line

features.theirs: Pages of 25 stories (Titles (73 pages on Lumos))
features.plus_one: pages of 25 with a jump to any page, and the address keeps the filters so a list can be shared

features.theirs: Series (story row)
features.plus_one: a series page reads its stories in order with reading progress

features.theirs: Chapters, word count and hits per story (story row)
features.plus_one: chapters, words, hits and a reading time on every row

features.theirs: Reviews and a star rating per story (story row)
features.plus_one: reviews per chapter with the count on the row, and a star rating that shows how many people gave it

features.theirs: Report a story (story row)
features.plus_one: report a story from its row, with the reason chosen from a short list

features.theirs: Keyword search (home page box, archive Search)
features.plus_one: search titles, summaries and authors from one box that works with every filter

features.theirs: Most recent stories and an RSS feed of the last 14 days (Most Recent)
features.plus_one: most recent with an RSS feed per archive, per author and per filter

features.theirs: Random story and featured story (archive home)
features.plus_one: a random story that respects the reader's filters and warnings, and a featured story with why it was picked

features.theirs: Register and log in (archive menu)
features.plus_one: an account that keeps favourites, follows and reading progress on every device

features.theirs: Rules, help, ratings guide and an uploading guide (archive menu and footer)
features.plus_one: rules, help, the ratings guide and the upload guide on one page each, in plain words

features.theirs: Site news with comments and a news archive (archive home, News & Notices)
features.plus_one: site news with comments and an archive by month

features.theirs: Featured fics lists (home page, Featured Fics)
features.plus_one: featured lists that open as a filtered catalog, not a page of links

features.theirs: Writing contest pages (home page)
features.plus_one: a contest page with its rules, its entries as a catalog and its winners

features.theirs: Several archives by subject under one site (Archive Descriptions (5 archives))
features.plus_one: archives by subject under one catalog, so one search and one account cover all of them

features.theirs: Forums and a help desk (top menu)
features.plus_one: a forum and a help desk on the same site, with no outside group needed

features.theirs: Staff, affiliates, contact, terms, disclaimer and credits pages (sidebar and footer)
features.plus_one: staff, contact, terms, disclaimer and credits pages, each short and linked from the footer
